reads.title: [AINews] Anthropic IPO: Whither Now?
reads.author: swyx .ai
reads.description: November 6, 2026 — ARC Prize tests Inkling 2 Small, and Thinking Machines explains how it caught early checkpoints bypassing guardrails.
reads.summary: It’s a relatively quiet news day, and the AI market rout we referenced obliquely two days ago has deepened, though it might be leveling off not even halfway into bear market territory (-10% on Nasdaq, not -20%). That said, everything being “priced to perfection” means any surprise that is not to the upside is probably to the downside, knocking valuation estimates down as low as $1T and probability down 18% .

reads.title: Controlling Biology - Fabian Theis, Helmholtz Munich
reads.author: RJ Honicky
reads.description: As systems biology efforts heat up to map biology at higher resolution, greater breadth and more modalities, Fabian Theis is pushing the frontier from mapping to predicting to controlling biology
reads.summary: Fabian Theis has been one of the key players in the various iterations of the Virtual Cell concept and initiatives. It is not hyperbole at all to say that his lab has been pushing the frontier of algorithms to understand multi-scale, multi-modal (”multiomics”), time-varying biological data.

reads.description: Learn regex matching in Python with re.search(), and use metacharacters, groups, lookarounds, and flags to find complex patterns in strings.
reads.summary: In this tutorial, you’ll explore regular expressions , also known as regexes , in Python. A regex is a special sequence of characters that defines a pattern for complex string-matching functionality.

reads.summary: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates.
